frame: mm; KiCad +Y down; Z=0 PCB component surface; positive Z above PCB

device.source: TI SLASEA8A DDV0044D/4218830A 08-2016, package outline; X/Y rotated with U1=90 deg; CAD height is not a measurement

thermal.rjc_source: TI SLASEA8A section 7.4; use Rjc(top), not Rja=2.4 under a fixed 85 C sink

height_envelopes.D303_source: Littelfuse SMCJ series JC.10/29/20 Dimensions D max 2.620 mm; DO-214AB

assembly_requirements: Positive metal stops at H5/H6; package is never a hard stop
Select equal stop/shim stacks to set the ACTUAL package-to-pedestal gap before tightening; do not infer it from maximum package height
Use qualified thin TIM >=3 W/mK; no 1 mm grease bridge
Select solid side shim thickness from actual lateral gap minus TWO thin TIM layers; nominal 0.90 mm is not a measured gap
J6 bond to the OEM profile is mandatory; electrical GND is not protective earth
Check bottom head clearance >=5 mm and local head/body interference before assembly
No standard 7 mm washer at H5/H6; maximum bottom bearing/head diameter 5.5 mm
Check useful OEM M3 thread depth; side M3x20 and bottom M3x10 are candidates, never blindly bottom a screw
